bagPolicy.summary: Bags should be no larger than A3 size and must fit under your seat. Guests are encouraged to arrive without a bag.
allowed: Bags up to A3 size that fit under your seat
Your own food in non-glass containers
prohibited: Any large item that cannot be placed under a seat
Professional cameras, video cameras and tripods
Flags or banners with handles over 1.6 metres
bagPolicy.note: Bags may be inspected and screened at entry. Concert promoters can add event-specific conditions.

parking.summary: On-site event parking is limited, so book early through UbiPark, which also handles accessible parking. Car park entrances are on Bourke Street (Entrances A and B) and Wurundjeri Way (Entrances D and E), with a 2.1 meter height limit. For parking questions, call Parking Services at (03) 8625 7201.

rideshare.summary: Taxi ranks are on Bourke Street opposite Platform 28 restaurant and on La Trobe Street near Peppers' Apartments.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
